name: pptx
description: PPTX is a scientific presentation output primitive for creating, reading, editing, validating, and rendering PowerPoint decks and templates. Use it for research briefings, lab meetings, conference talks, posters, speaker notes, charts, and template-derived presentations.
capabilities: Create and edit structured slide decks and templates.
Preserve layouts, charts, images, speaker notes, and OOXML package relationships.
Render and validate the final deck, including text fit, charts, and slide structure.
requirements: PPTX generation or OOXML editing toolchain.
A slide outline, template, or source deck when editing.
